objective.text: The objective of SPICE is to better understand the complex process of combustion by observing flames in a microgravity environment aboard the International Space Station and analogous ground experiments.
objective.quote: The objective of SPICE is to better understand the complex process of combustion by observing flames in a microgravity environment aboard the International Space Station (ISS) and analogous ground experiments.

fuel.text: Fuels tested included methane, ethylene, propane, propylene, and propylene mixtures.
fuel.quote: Fuels tested included methane, ethylene, propane, propylene, and propylene mixtures.

sample_geometry.text: Specific objectives were to identify the laminar smoke-point properties of non-buoyant jet diffusion flames under various co-flow conditions in microgravity.
sample_geometry.quote: Identify the laminar smoke-point properties of non-buoyant jet diffusion flames under various co-flow conditions in microgravity.

flow.text: Co-flow velocities ranged from 5.4 cm/s to 65 cm/s.
flow.quote: co-flow velocities ranging from 5.4 cm/s to 65 cm/s.

variables.text: Burner diameters of 0.41 mm, 0.76 mm, and 1.6 mm and co-flow velocities ranging from 5.4 cm/s to 65 cm/s were used.
variables.quote: burner diameters of 0.41 mm, 0.76 mm, and 1.6 mm and co-flow velocities ranging from 5.4 cm/s to 65 cm/s.

measurements.text: Measurements included flame height, radiative heat losses, and co-flow air velocity distributions.
measurements.quote: Measurements included flame height, radiative heat losses, and co-flow air velocity distributions.

safety_finding.text: The research will improve our understanding of soot formation mechanisms and help design safer spacecraft environments.
safety_finding.quote: Will improve our understanding of soot formation mechanisms and help design safer spacecraft environments.

earth_benefits.text: The research could possibly provide insights to better fuel formulations and combustion processes.
earth_benefits.quote: Could possibly provide insights to better fuel formulations and combustion processes.
